title: agents-inc: Cross-Vendor Governance for an Agentic-AI Workforce
description:
agents-inc runs AI models the way a company runs staff: a Lead takes your request, delegates it down an org chart of cheaper Worker models, and accepts nothing until a reviewer signs off. It is a Python package that hands work from one AI coding session to other models and checks the result before anyone accepts it. It supports Claude, Codex, Gemini, Mistral and OpenRouter capacity, so you can delegate as you please across subscriptions. A four-rung ladder (Executive, Orchestrator, Workhorse, Grunt) sets the model management. A model never grades its own work: each result passes deterministic checks, then a reviewer, and the decision goes into an append-only ledger. The main entry point is the agents-inc command (dispatch, doctor, repair, ledger). Install with pip install agents-inc, then run agents-inc install; the import name is agents_inc. The project is experimental, and no measurements of efficacy have been benchmarked yet.

This release (0.6.1)

0.6.1 replaces 0.6.0, which was withdrawn, so these notes cover both. Delegation now works from inside the Claude Code sandbox, every Codex seat is reachable with zero setup, the test suite runs on three operating systems in CI, and two Claude Code mods let you watch and steer delegates from panes beside the chat.

Added

  • Slots schema. Every --slots file is validated against dispatch_record.v1, and the run record carries the file hash (#131).
  • All four Codex seats. The DelegateAgent MCP server offers luna, terra, sol and astra, with an effort level and thread resume, and ships inside the mod (#127).
  • Three-OS CI. The unittest suite runs on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows; the Windows job is advisory until the port lands (#138).
  • Observe: agents-manager and luna-pane mods. /agents-manager opens a pane with a tree of the session's agents and recent dispatch runs; a row opens that run's live events in its own pane. /luna-pane streams the newest luna or haiku delegate's events as they arrive.
  • Interact from the pane. Start a delegate by picking the model, effort and task; message a running agent; cancel a running run; or ask an agent to stop and report. Free-model starts (gemini, mistral, openrouter) list and open like dispatch runs (#141).

Changed

  • The FAN_OUT and chain lints accept more forms, print the expected one on failure, and name each missing element; GATES given as a string is refused (#135).
  • sol routes to gpt-6.1-sol.

Fixed

  • A dispatch from inside the Claude Code Bash sandbox probes the API through the sandbox proxy and runs instead of refusing; a hook denies compound dispatch calls that defeat the exclusion rule (#136).
  • Every run writes a returned ledger row; an empty Codex result is an error; uninstall no longer reports a false conflict.
  • luna finds its Codex catalog entry when Codex caches an older model of the same family.

Roadmap at 0.6.1

  • Now: measure the token cost of delegation against doing the work in one session, and port the test suite to Windows (#138).
  • Next: let a Worker launched by a broker lead its own Workers (#73).
  • Later: route work by data classification (#19).

Cite as: DO Mattioli (2026). agents-inc: Cross-Vendor Governance for an Agentic-AI Workforce. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22670100
